briefdescription.para: Base entity for appointment tables shared by the service-specific appointment classes.

detaileddescription.para: Appointment extends the generic Entity with two static permission-query builders. One fetches the owner, admin and staff of a service (organisation) by its id; the other finds the owning service from an appointment id by joining the appointment table to its organisation table. Concrete classes fix the table and organisation names and expose these helpers to PermissionManager, which uses them to authorise appointment operations.

WHY THIS FILE MATTERS IN THE SERVER: Appointments belong to a service (a clinic, pharmacy, laboratory or radiology centre), so access must be checked against that service's owner/admin/staff rather than the appointment alone. Controllers call the queries produced here before allowing an appointment to be created or read. Without Appointment, each service-specific appointment class would duplicate this ownership lookup and permission checks would be inconsistent.

CONCEPTS TO LEARN (for beginners):
std::optional: https://en.cppreference.com/w/cpp/utility/optional
Static member function: belongs to the class, not an object, so it is called as Class::fn().
SQL JOIN: combines rows from two tables using a related column (here a foreign key to the service id), letting us find the owning service from an appointment id.
SQL parameter binding: put $1, $2, ... markers in the SQL and pass the real values separately; see https://en.cppreference.com/w/cpp or the libpqxx documentation. (These permission queries are the exception: they use only internal, trusted names and ids.)
